name: tomlsmith
description: TOML language support powered by the TomlSmith language server.
author: Nirvana-Jie <1357711537@qq.com>

virtualWorkspaces.description: TomlSmith needs to spawn the tomlsmith-lsp executable, which requires a real filesystem workspace.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Restricted Mode ignores workspace overrides of the server launch settings.

semanticTokenTypes.description: TOML date, time, and date-time values reported by the TomlSmith language server.
Invalid or unrecognized TOML syntax reported by the TomlSmith language server.

tomlsmith.server.path.description: Path or command name for tomlsmith-lsp. When not set explicitly, the extension prefers a server binary bundled with the extension and otherwise resolves tomlsmith-lsp from PATH. Changing this setting automatically restarts the language server.

tomlsmith.server.arguments.description: Additional arguments passed to tomlsmith-lsp. Changing this setting automatically restarts the language server.

tomlsmith.server.environment.description: Environment variables added when launching tomlsmith-lsp. Changing this setting automatically restarts the language server.

tomlsmith.toml.version.description: TOML language version used for validation and formatting. Both 1.0 and 1.1 are published specifications; 1.0 is the compatibility default for ecosystem files. Takes effect immediately without restarting the language server.

tomlsmith.format.indentWidth.description: Indent width used by the formatter. When null the formatter follows the editor tab size.

tomlsmith.format.lineWidth.description: Preferred line width used by the formatter.

tomlsmith.format.lineEnding.description: Line-ending policy used by the formatter.

tomlsmith.format.generatedFiles.description: Whether Format Document touches generated files such as Cargo.lock, poetry.lock, pdm.lock, uv.lock, or files carrying an @generated marker.
